Ambetter of Tennessee

PO Box 10341  
Van Nuys, CA 91410  

Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination  
Member: Sawyer Iverson  
Member ID: W437498644  
Reference number: POC-C1EE0F5DA7-11270  
Requested service: Bunion surgery for hallux valgus  
CPT: 28296  
Date of denial notice: August 10, 2026  

Dear Appeals and Grievances Department:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for CPT 28296, correction of hallux valgus with bunionectomy and distal metatarsal osteotomy. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The submitted clinical information supports the medical necessity of the requested procedure:

- I have had 12 months of progressive foot pain that has not resolved with rest.
- I completed 16 weeks of conservative treatment from March 20, 2026, through July 10, 2026, including activity modification, wide toe-box footwear, and a custom orthotic. The physical therapy discharge note documents 20 completed visits.
- I used NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 25, 2026, produced only 2 weeks of partial relief.
- Weight-bearing radiographs dated June 29, 2026, show a hallux valgus angle of 38 degrees and an intermetatarsal angle of 17 degrees.
- The condition substantially impairs function. I cannot tolerate closed shoes, and the prominence creates a risk of ulceration.
- Examination documents positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection. I am a nonsmoker, have a BMI of 29, and have no untreated substance-use condition documented.

These records show a persistent, progressive, painful deformity with functional limitation and inadequate response to prolonged nonoperative treatment. They also provide objective examination and imaging findings supporting the requested surgical correction.

Please reconsider the denial and approve CPT 28296. If Ambetter believes any specific information remains missing, please identify each missing item precisely and allow submission of that information for review. Please also provide the complete Ambetter of Tennessee medical-necessity policy or clinical review criteria actually applied to CPT 28296, including the policy title, policy number, version or effective date, and the specific documentation requirements used in this determination. No plan medical policy has been quoted in this appeal because the applicable policy text was not provided with the denial and was not identified in the publicly available materials reviewed.

Please review the enclosed records:

1. Physical therapy discharge note documenting 20 visits from March 20, 2026, through July 10, 2026  
2. Documentation of activity modification, wide toe-box footwear, and custom orthotic use  
3. Medication history documenting 8 months of NSAID treatment with inadequate relief  
4. Injection record dated May 25, 2026  
5. Weight-bearing foot radiographs and report dated June 29, 2026  
6. Orthopedic examination documenting pain-limited range of motion and positive provocative testing  
7. Clinical documentation regarding inability to tolerate closed shoes and ulceration risk  
8. Surgical recommendation and supporting records from Reyes, MD  

Please send written confirmation that this appeal has been received and notify me of the appeal determination. The appeal is submitted within the deadline stated in the denial notice.

Sincerely,

Sawyer Iverson  
Member ID: W437498644
